title: Binary Tree Right Side View
tip: Level-order; last node on each level.
statement: Given the root of a binary tree, imagine yourself standing on the **right side** of it. Return the values of the nodes you can see ordered from top to bottom.
constraints: The number of nodes is in [0, 100].
followUp: DFS visiting right first also works.
editorial: BFS. Append the last node of each level. Or DFS right-first, record the first visit at each depth.
